supportedClaims: Persisted symmetry tapering evidence with independent symplectic GF(2) verification, optional confined target-sector spectrum replay (<=6 qubits, <=256 terms) and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Automatic symmetry discovery, contextual-subspace VQE, global ground-state optimality across unselected sectors or dense spectrum checks beyond 6 qubits or 256 terms.
Independent proof of upstream Symmer implementation correctness.

checks.criterion: Persisted tapering request satisfies its JSON Schema and valid Pauli symmetry contract.
Persisted tapering result satisfies its JSON Schema.
Symmetry generators are independent over GF(2) by independent symplectic row elimination.
Symmetry generators commute pairwise under the symplectic inner product.
Every symmetry commutes with every nonzero term of the original Hamiltonian.
Reduced qubit count n-k, sector dimension 2^(n-k), distinct Pauli words and finite real coefficients agree.
Reported reference mode binds to the requested referenceMode.
Confined request-only Python spectrum reference binds the original request and candidate reduced operator; the Host runner requires enforcement full.
When within <=6 qubits, <=256 terms and reference enabled, independent target-sector projection reproduces the full reduced eigenspectrum and ground energy.
When the Tool reports a computed spectrum reference, its reported spectra and error metrics agree with independent recomputation.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; optional reference availability cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
